title: Gemini gets a fallback route
summary:
Gemini gained a fallback route, the elevator game returned to its terminal roots, and app-key setup got a little less fiddly.

Public `gemini` requests now go to Airforce first, with Vertex handling unsupported requests and configured error responses. Explicit `code_execution` requests can use Vertex, while Gemini thinking responses are preserved.

The Sirius Cybernetics Elevator Challenge restored its ASCII look and replaced automatic login redirects with a button. Its app-key update fixes the authorization flow; the game also adds OpenAI to the model selector, keeps conversation history when switching to Marvin, and sends personas the full conversation.

New app-key dialogs now pre-fill `http://localhost/callback` as a redirect URI. Developers can adjust the path for their dev server; redirects still need to match the app’s allowlist.

highlights.title: Elevator game, terminal edition
highlights.text: Play the Sirius Cybernetics Elevator Challenge in its restored ASCII style. Choose OpenAI, DeepSeek, or Claude Fast, and switch to Marvin without losing your conversation.
